sb.title: Backups
sb.lead: A snapshot holds a backup of every package; restoring it rolls the whole server back. Its backups are counted under Worlds, Modules and Systems.
sb.deleteTip: Delete this snapshot and the backups in it
sb.noneText: A snapshot backs up every world, module and system at once, so you can roll the whole server back, for example before updating Foundry.

sb.tag.newer.taken: Taken with a newer Foundry ({build}); it can't be restored here.
